cve_summary: WriteTIFFImage in coders/tiff.c in ImageMagick 7.0.8-43 Q16 allows attackers to cause a denial-of-service (application crash resulting from a heap-based buffer over-read) via a crafted TIFF image file, related to TIFFRewriteDirectory, TIFFWriteDirectory, TIFFWriteDirectorySec, and TIFFWriteDirectoryTagColormap in tif_dirwrite.c of LibTIFF. NOTE: this occurs because of an incomplete fix for CVE-2019-11597.
docstring:
Summary: This code fragment handles the printing and writing of a TIFF directory using the TIFF library.

Parameters: N/A

Returns: N/A

Logic: The code first calls `TIFFPrintDirectory`, which prints the contents of the TIFF directory to the standard output. The `MagickFalse` argument indicates that the printing should not include additional information. Following this, it attempts to write the TIFF directory back to the file using `TIFFWriteDirectory`. If the write operation fails (indicated by a return value of 0), it sets the `status` variable to `MagickFalse` and breaks out of the current loop or block, signaling an error in the directory writing process. This fragment is part of a larger function that likely manages TIFF file operations, ensuring that any issues during writing are handled gracefully.
